text:
liam_support: Heads-up — Plantera trial showing a sharp activation drop after yesterday's embed rollout. ~15% of embedding calls returning 500s, renewal in 10 days. Escalating to CS for priority handoff. ticket: <https://redsupport.internal/SUP-4567|SUP-4567> :warning:

maya_cs: ACK. Can you paste a short timeline and a couple sample logs?

liam_support: Spike started ~2026-03-21T12:03Z. Quick logs below from the ingestion worker (sanitized):
```
2026-03-21T12:03:07Z plantera embed id=abc123 code=500 msg="kv cache overflow"
2026-03-21T12:03:08Z plantera embed id=abc124 latency=1200ms
2026-03-21T12:03:09Z plantera embed id=abc125 code=500 msg="kv cache overflow"
```

raj_support: looks like a cache eviction/TTL mismatch with the new prefix-caching behavior in embed-v2 that rolled yesterday. Repro locally with larger batch sizes.

sandeep_sre: I'm seeing GPU queue pressure on g5-7 for the cluster serving embed-v2. Short-term mitigation: route to `embed-lite` (lower mem, quantized) or reduce batch size for this tenant. Can flip routing via feature flag.

maya_cs: Proposed comms + handoff plan (short):
1) Immediate: notify customer with transparent note + ask for any change they made to payloads.
2) Mitigation: route Plantera to `embed-lite` for next 24-48h.
3) Monitor: 1hr, 4hr, 24hr checks and share metrics.
4) Follow-up: schedule a 30m sync this week to go over docs and embed chunking guidance.

maya_cs: @olivia_csm can you own the customer message and cadence? We want to avoid alarm but be clear about mitigation. :memo:

olivia_csm: I got it. Drafting now. Will include: what happened, mitigation steps, ask for payload examples, and an offer for a short enablement session. Will ping sales lead for renewal context.

liam_support: I can flip routing once Olivia posts the comms. Added tag `escalation:priority` to SUP-4567 and noted the suggested fallback config: `{ "route": "embed-lite", "max_batch": 8 }`.

alert-bot: Incident SUP-4567 severity set to P1 by liam_support.

maya_cs: Also capturing feedback for enablement: customer reported onboarding docs unclear around chunking and rate limits for large batches. I'll log this to the enablement tracker.

olivia_csm: Adding a short how-to note and scheduling a 15min walkthrough option for Plantera. I'll paste the draft message to the ticket before sending.

raj_support: No objections from support. Once routing flips, I'll run a smoke test and post results here.

sandeep_sre: I'll keep an eye on infra and be ready to scale temporary capacity if needed. If things don't stabilize in 24h we should consider a canary rollback of embed-v2 for multi-tenant route.

maya_cs: Handoff checklist: 1) Customer notified, 2) Routing flipped, 3) Smoke test green, 4) Metrics at 1/4/24h posted to ticket, 5) Renewal flagged to account owner. I'll update SUP-4567 and add the enablement action item.

liam_support: Thanks everyone — marking support side as handed off. Ping me if you need quick follow-up during the flip.

olivia_csm: Sending draft in 5. Will include a short apology, steps taken, and an invite for a walkthrough.

maya_cs: Closing loop here — capture lessons and feed into docs backlog. :white_check_mark:
